title: Replace gameplay wave portals with shared ground breaches
context: The owner requested a quake-length animation, cracks beneath emerging creatures, reliable preset copying, exact TRON settings, and integration into the real game.
outcome: Normal wave sources now reuse the Sinkhole Lab effect on the unit sphere. The 6.984-second sequence clears real walls within an arc radius, updates floor cuts and navigation, then releases growing/fading creatures from the cavity. Mounted towers, the server and pending Isao construction are protected; source health, income, wave counts and mission supply rules remain. Accepted defaults: pre-roll 1.6, radius 1, heave -0.12, width 1.15, crack length 2, arms 12, debris 24, TRON. Base 7 presets add a breach subject with v2-v6 migration, full-package exports, compact copy feedback, clipboard fallback and review/apply. Defaults were promoted through the shared writer. The existing user missile working copies remain untouched. Local server restarted to load schema 7.
alternatives: Initial integration left particle billboards at lab scale; scale them with the host frame.
Shared materials were multiplied repeatedly by bloom, eventually overflowing and producing a black frame. Weight each material once and restore exact colours/visibility.
Unprotected wall clearance cancelled startup tower orders and failed cold-open acceptance. Pending Isao sites now survive environmental breach clearance.
evidence: npm run check and npm run build passed; release 6a1699e8
npm run test:browser passed (source), including cold-open, missions, shared models and preset isolation
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --breach-game and --dist --breach-game passed real wall clearance, emergence, stable material colours and restart
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --sinkhole and --dist --sinkhole passed timing, depth order, waves, both palettes, copy feedback/fallback and cleanup
node scripts/browser-test.mjs --local-authoring passed review/apply/undo and game reload
